# Legal Framework

The Legal Framework topic centers on a single, specific legal point that recurs across two documents in the corpus: whether specialist psychologists (in Danish, *specialpsykologer*) are legally permitted to issue psychiatric diagnoses. This question sits at the intersection of two related entities, [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] and [[specialpsykologer|Specialpsykologer]], and it matters because it defines who is authorized, under Danish law, to make the kind of clinical determination — such as an ADHD diagnosis — that this wiki's corpus repeatedly documents.

According to material referenced by [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], specialist psychologists are legally permitted to issue psychiatric diagnoses: "Specialpsykologer lovgivningsmæssigt gerne må stille psykiatriske diagnoser" [^src1]. This same legal point is echoed, and effectively confirmed, in a separate claim directly attributed to [[specialpsykologer|Specialpsykologer]] itself, which states that specialist psychologists may issue psychiatric diagnoses according to the legislation: "Specialpsykologer må stille psykiatriske diagnoser ifølge lovgivningen" [^src1]. The consistency between these two sourced statements — one appearing in pages 26-30 of the 2023 document and the other in pages 66-70 of the 2024 document — suggests this legal authorization is a stable, recurring fact within the corpus rather than a one-off assertion, and that it is treated as an established feature of the Danish legal landscape around psychiatric diagnosis across both editions of the source material.

## Claims

**ADHD_2023.pdf, page 26** (from `wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2023.pdf`, pages 26-30):
- Specialpsykologer lovgivningsmæssigt gerne må stille psykiatriske diagnoser [^src1] (adhd-databasen) — Type: legal-framework

**ADHD_2024.pdf, page 69** (from `wikis/rkkp-adhd/raw/ADHD_2024.pdf`, pages 66-70):
- Specialpsykologer må stille psykiatriske diagnoser ifølge lovgivningen [^src1] (specialpsykologer) — Type: legal-framework
